canDo: Keep your French active, your strategy clear and your confidence up, without bringing in any new system on the last day.
review: Look only at your personal error rules, chunks and exam routine.
input: Light authentic input: RFI or TV5MONDE, your choice.
output: A short writing outline + light speaking; no high-pressure full mock.
checkpoint: Can describe the routine for all four papers, your personal top 3 risks and how you will handle them.
challenge: Today’s challenge (light, nothing new): listen to a story that interests you in RFI’s « Journal en français facile », retell it aloud in 1 minute and add one sentence of your own view; then look through your personal error rules and chunk list, reading only, not studying. Finally write 3 sentences in French on how you plan to keep learning after the exam (e.g. Chaque matin, j'écouterai dix minutes de RFI.).

questions.why: The exercises with ready-made questions are the TV5MONDE ones.
